metadata.title: Liangzai · Tech News and Briefings
metadata.description: Follow daily news on post-quantum algorithms, quantum-safe migration and protocols, standards, cybersecurity, AI and the NGCC public-key call. Read the original sources and run real algorithms in the crypto lab.
metadata.imageAlt: Blue light on the cryptography vault door · Liangzai Tech Briefings

hero.title:
Learn a little
every day
hero.description: I’m Yibiao. I work on post-quantum cryptography and secure protocols. This is my little kitchen for curious minds, with a daily briefing, a lab that runs real algorithms, and two characters keeping me company, Liangzai and Naiwa.

noon: Take a sip before getting back to work.
evening: there’s still a little left in today’s bottle.

naiwa.alt: Naiwa, a butter-yellow frog with a round belly and green eye rings, sitting with a half-full bottle

news: Ribbit. What happened in the world today?
algorithms: Why can old keys be cracked?
lab: Can you really generate keys in a browser?
story: How did Liangzai and I meet?

noon.title: From algorithms to protocols
noon.description: See how a handshake establishes a key, authenticates peers and fits into existing systems.
noon.labTitle:
Try key encapsulation
in your browser
noon.labDescription: Generate an ML-KEM key pair, encapsulate and decapsulate, then compare the shared secrets. You can also import test vectors and check signing and verification.

hybrid: See how classical algorithms and ML-KEM work together, and how their shared secrets feed into protocol key derivation.
agility: Connect algorithm selection, parameter settings and protocol negotiation to support a phased migration.
interop: Use standard vectors, cross-implementation tests and handshake timings to check correctness and measure the cost.

family.title: One measures, one stands guard
family.description: Two different approaches to technology, brought to life as two little characters.

liangzai.name: Liangzai
liangzai.alt: Liangzai in blue and white armor with a blue antenna
liangzai.description: He measures everything before he can relax. News sources, handshake times and every test vector are his responsibility.

naiwa.name: Naiwa
naiwa.alt: Naiwa standing steady, with a butter-yellow body, round belly and green eye rings
naiwa.description: Round and quiet, he never backs away. He holds the milk bottle and keeps everyone going a little longer while they wait for an answer.

night.title:
A bedtime story
after the engineering
night.description: Journey Among the Stars is an eleven-page illustrated and narrated story about Liangzai and Naiwa facing Lord Shor together. In the story, he still goes by Nailong. He listens every night and usually drifts off before page nine.
night.coverAlt: Book cover showing Liangzai and Nailong protecting the Quantum Star back to back
night.listenerAlt: A sleepy Naiwa holding a blue picture book

metadata.title: About · Wang Yibiao
metadata.description: Yibiao’s personal website. I studied cybersecurity at Shandong University from 2018 to 2025 and now work at China Telecom Quantum Group on post-quantum cryptography, secure protocols and cryptographic engineering.

hero.label: My profile
hero.intro: From Shandong University onward, exploring cryptography and security
hero.bio: I earned my bachelor’s and master’s degrees in cybersecurity at Shandong University and now work at China Telecom Quantum Group. This is where I document my technical work and share experiments in code and design.
hero.alt: Naiwa waving hello with a milk bottle in one hand

journey.title: How I got here
journey.description: Seven years at Shandong University, from studying cybersecurity to working in quantum security

work.description: I bring cryptography and security research into engineering practice, with a focus on quantum-safe protocol migration, crypto agility and the combined use of PQC and QKD.

master.description: I continued studying and researching cybersecurity, building on the foundations of my undergraduate degree.

bachelor.description: I began studying cybersecurity at Shandong University and discovered cryptography and security technology.

protocols.description: I explore quantum-safe migration, hybrid key exchange and crypto agility in TLS, TLCP, SSH and IKE.
